changes.text: The chart is one tab stop (was one per point): Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between points, and the last-focused point keeps the tab stop.
Points are `role="img"` with their `aria-label` (was `role="button"` with no action) and use `cursor: default`. The `.point-label` text is `aria-hidden="true"`, so each point is announced once.
The tooltip is `aria-hidden="true"` and no longer `role="status"`, since the point's `aria-label` already carries the same label and values. Escape hides it, on focus and on hover.

Point colours come from the shared `CHART_PALETTE`, built from the palette slots: `--ss-accent`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-magenta`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow`, `--ss-green` (was `--ss-primary`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-purple`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow`, `--ss-lime`). A custom palette now recolours the points.

New component: a two-axis scatter plot with optional quadrant reference lines (`xRef` / `yRef` + `quadrantLabels`), sqrt-scaled bubble sizing, direct point labels and a hover/focus tooltip. Axes use the padded data extent instead of starting at zero.
